Tech Jobs Showcase – Hobart

14 May 2026 5:30PM - 7:30PM

Attention Employers – join our employment networking event bringing together employers, educators and placement organisations.

This two‑part series (Launceston + Hobart) explores how Tasmanian ICT businesses can modernise employment practices, embrace the SFIA employment framework, and create real pathways into tech careers for the growing tech workforce.

✅ Practical insights on hiring, placements and skills development
✅ Connections between employers and placement agencies

✅ Launch TasICT’s Placement Focus,  designed to bridge the gap between employers and placement agencies

An event series specifically designed for employers and placement agencies to discuss growing capability, creating opportunity, and strengthening Tasmania’s tech future

Tickets: $25 TasICT members/ $35 non- members

Time: 5:30pm – 7.30pm

Includes drinks and canapes

Hobart: Thurs 14th May: Register Here
